today.theme: Respond clearly in a fast-moving meeting
today.source: Stanford Engineering — The future of effective communication
today.listen_task: First pass: notice the contrast between reacting quickly and choosing the right moment to speak. With the transcript, find the two things the speaker says to consider before contributing in a busy meeting.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, imagine a team discussion is moving quickly. Say what the goal is, give one concise point, and explain when you would wait before adding it.

phrases.note: Use this to focus a fast discussion on the immediate outcome.

phrases.phrase: I might wait until the appropriate moment to contribute.
phrases.note: Show that timing your input can be a deliberate choice.
Signal a short, focused contribution before sharing your point.
